topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I don’t know how many times I’ve walked past that damned wall, thinking it was just another solid piece of nothing. Then, one day, I push, and it gives. Behind it, a room I never knew existed, like a secret, silent heart to this old house. Books line the walls, ancient and forbidden, as if waiting for someone who could finally understand their silence. The furniture is all antique, like the room was sealed off a century ago and just now remembered to breathe. I should be surprised, maybe even a little intrigued, but instead, I feel a restlessness, a need to uncover every last corner this place has tried to hide.
